# Tabler Icons

Source: https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons/tree/v3.34.1/icons/outline
Version: v3.34.1, MIT. License: `LICENSES/tabler-icons-MIT.txt`.

Pentad vendors the needed SVGs under `quickshell/assets/icons/tabler`. Changes: removed upstream YAML comments, replaced `currentColor` with symbolic black so Quickshell can recolor them, and standardized the outline stroke width to 2.5 on the original 24px grid.
